niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
Top online courses for shadow work and spiritual practice blend depth psychology, somatic tools, and spiritual integration:
Encounters with the Shadow (Jung Platform): Led by renowned Jungian analyst James Hollis, this 4-hour program explores shadow formation, projections in relationships, dreams, and repeating behavioral patterns. (Price: $127) Jung Platform
Embracing the Shadow (Awake Academy): Taught by Charlie Morley, this 7-week course combines Tibetan Buddhist methods with mindfulness and Western psychology, utilizing guided meditations and dream work. www.awakeacademy.org
Hunt Your Own Shadow (Zachary Phillips): A 12-week self-paced program by a psychotherapist designed to process unconscious limiting beliefs and heavy emotional triggers through structured weekly audio and journaling.
Shamanic Shadow Work for Healing the Fragmented Self (Udemy): Guided by Tom and Stevie, this course merges shadow psychology with shamanic practices like drumming, inner child reconnection, and soul integration. Udemy
The Complete Shadow Work Course (Udemy): A practical, beginner-friendly breakdown of ego death, identity transformation, childhood conditioning, and shadow journaling. Udemy
Facing the Shadow (Big Shakti): Teaches why spiritual awakening requires integrating both light and dark aspects, offering self-paced guidance with teacher support. Big Shakti
Are you looking for a structured long-term program (like 12 weeks) or a short introductory workshop?
Do you prefer a purely psychological/Jungian approach or a spiritual/shamanic framework?
